terms.meaning: Writing a document into the books. A posted invoice is owed by the customer; until then it is a draft you can change.
A document still being written. Only a draft can be changed or deleted; after that, you cancel or void it.
Undoing a posted document so it no longer counts, while keeping it on record with the reason.
The list of accounts your books use. A new organisation starts with one for its country.
The prices you sell at, for a place or a kind of customer.
